title: Tenant-scoped dashboard audit logs
summary: Scope dashboard audit records to the actor organization before taking 25 entries; preserve platform administrator visibility and the learner empty-list contract.
Add synthetic two-organization audit fixtures and a real local HTTP regression covering staff, platform administrators and learners; nineteen tests, type checking and the workspace build pass.
Add a source-linked CRUD course with exact original snapshots, worked examples, practice solutions and recorded verification evidence.
limits: The store remains an in-memory teaching implementation with synthetic records.
No authentication, persistence, notification, or external integration redesign was attempted.

checks.command: npm test -- --pool=threads --poolOptions.threads.singleThread=true --testTimeout=30000; npm run typecheck; npm run build
checks.environment: Node 22.16; npm 10.9.2; Vitest 2; actual local HTTP API with synthetic in-memory fixtures; no PostgreSQL connection
